events.context: User provides text about AI governance veil-piercing paper with legal research brief, including cases, statutory frameworks, and analysis.

Extract case ICO v Clearview AI: UKUT 319 (AAC) 2025, Upper Tribunal allows ICO appeal, establishes territorial scope for behavioral monitoring, rejects material scope exclusion for private companies, maps to autonomy-control conflation.

Extract case Schrems II: CJEU invalidates EU-US Privacy Shield, upholds SCCs with conditions, DPC enforcement saga leads to €1.2 billion fine, maps to oversight board dynamics and institutional design lessons.

Extract case Garcia v. Character Technologies: M.D. Fla. 2024, settled 2026, court holds AI as product, AI output not speech, individual founder liability, maps to profit-driven manipulation and veil-piercing theories.

Extract case Hangzhou Internet Court 2025: first Chinese AI hallucination dispute, dismisses claims, classifies AI as service with fault-based liability, dynamic systems theory for duty of care, contrasts with Garcia.

Extract case German Facebook/Bundeskartellamt: BGH 2020 reframes as imposed extension of services, CJEU 2023 endorses competition authorities assessing GDPR compliance, maps to competition law as AI governance tool.

Extract statutory framework EU AI Act: Regulation 2024/1689, tiered risk classification, prohibitions, high-risk requirements, conformity assessment, AILD withdrawal creates liability gap, maps to graduated veil-piercing.

Extract statutory framework China's Interim Measures for Generative AI Services: effective 2023, training data governance, content labeling, provider obligations, enforcement actions, comparison with ethical ledger concept.

Extract statutory framework UK Data Protection Act 2018 and DUAA 2025: Article 22 UK GDPR, DUAA reforms with more permissive framework, meaningful human involvement statutory, EU adequacy implications.
